name: Ka Chia-yün
bio: Ka Chia-yün is the spelling Giles uses for this poet of the 8th century AD. His poem here is a dawn poem of longing.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: At Dawn
poems.author: Ka Chia-yün
poems.text:
Drive the young orioles away,
Nor let them on the branches play;
Their chirping breaks my slumber through
And keeps me from my dreams of you.
